verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses AI training data opt-out or a data-use policy control for AI features (Agent Mode/Postbot); in fact community reports raise concerns about data/telemetry being sent to Postman's servers without any documented opt-out for AI training use. Missing for 10: any documentation of an AI-training opt-out setting, privacy policy statement on model training, or admin control to restrict data use for AI training.
